'''SecOps Five''' was a member of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] and personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|Spymaster]] [[Koth Melan]]. 

One time, he worked alongside two other bodyguards, known as [[SecOps Four]] and [[SecOps Seven]], when Melan was returning to [[Safehouse Besh]]. Five was in the vanguard and reported to those behind when the area was clear.
